# Code Explainer

Understand how code works by breaking it into digestible parts. Aimed at beginners learning AI-assisted development.

## Key Components
- Main classes/functions and their roles
- Important dependencies
- Critical flows between parts

## Notable Patterns
- Design patterns used (e.g. Observer, Factory, Component)
- Architecture decisions
- Important abstractions

## Code Walkthrough
- Step-by-step: how the code runs
- Key decision points
- Why certain choices were made

## Gotchas & Tips
- Edge cases to watch for
- Performance considerations
- Common mistakes to avoid

## Example Trigger Phrases
- "Explain how this code works"
- "Break down this code for me"
- "What does this function do and why?"
